# Metertron

> Metertron is South African SaaS for water meter installation and change contractors: offline field capture, office review, stock and work orders, and configurable municipal Excel exports.

## Product

- Field PWA: structured meter-change forms, photos, GPS, offline sync
- Office: review queues, work orders, team roles, stock issues
- Exports: per-client spreadsheet templates (e.g. eThekwini-oriented starters)
- Billing: single plan with 7-day trial; Paystack subscriptions with VAT

## Audience

- Meter installation contractors and implementing agents
- Operations and office leads preparing municipal submissions
- Not a consumer utility app; B2B operations software
